name: chat-peninsular
description: Mensajería interna self-hosted para equipos pequeños

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @chat-peninsular/types build && concurrently -n web,server -c green,blue "pnpm --filter @chat-peninsular/web dev" "pnpm --filter @chat-peninsular/server dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @chat-peninsular/types build && pnpm --filter @chat-peninsular/server build && pnpm --filter @chat-peninsular/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @chat-peninsular/types typecheck && pnpm --filter @chat-peninsular/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @chat-peninsular/web typecheck
